mechanism.claim: A completed London session in which minute-level safe-haven strengthening variance dominates weakening variance across both JPY and CHF identifies broad defensive hedging pressure; the opposite identifies hedge release. During locally elevated BTC variation, BTC relays in the opposite direction of safe-haven pressure for eight hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the pooled JPY-plus-CHF safe-haven semivariance imbalance
mechanism.why_distinct: Dollar breadth uses session endpoint directions; FX synchronization uses correlation; HVSCRD uses a JPY-minus-CHF standardized endpoint return; HVSVL chooses the higher-variation pair. HVSIS instead pools both safe havens and decomposes every completed minute into strengthening versus weakening quadratic variation. It uses no endpoint-return tail, pair leader, BTC return direction, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC trailing 24-hour realized variation must rank in the upper 35 percent against the 20 strictly prior source-valid sessions, adapting causally to local volatility regimes such as July-like transitions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a fixed 13:05 UTC external-FX intraday semivariance clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: exact observed bars_polygon one-minute rows during weekday [07:00,13:00) UTC
features.session_valid: each pair has at least 330 distinct minutes, first no later than 07:05, last no earlier than 12:55, every OHLC finite positive and coherent; no imputation
features.minute_safehaven_return: negative log(close/open) for each exact observed USDJPY and USDCHF minute
features.strengthening_semivariance: sum squares of strictly positive minute_safehaven_return across both pairs
features.weakening_semivariance: sum squares of strictly negative minute_safehaven_return across both pairs
features.semivariance_imbalance: (strengthening_semivariance-weakening_semivariance)/(strengthening_semivariance+weakening_semivariance); denominator strict positive and numerator strict nonzero
features.imbalance_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute semivariance_imbalance over at most 60 prior jointly valid sessions, minimum 40, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over the 20 prior source-valid weekday decisions, minimum 15, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 13:00 UTC after both sessions complete
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT perpetual D 13:05 UTC open
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent pooled intraday safehaven semivariance mechanism with causal local-volatility state

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no pair universe, session, minute-return law, semivariance formula, histories, ranks, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
